name: Little Talhovi
description: Little Talhovi was a world located in the Little Talhovi system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane connected it to the Talhovi system. Little Talhovi was considered to be a promising agriworld by 43 ABY and, like the rest of the Senex-Juvex worlds, was under the control of the region's aristocratic Ancient Houses.
